{{Top}}
'''Antigrav''' referred to any device that countered the effects of gravity. A [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] was the most common type of antigrav. Any propulsion system on a vehicle employing antigrav technology was called an '''antigrav drive'''.
